edit.text: - A purpose verb (为充分运用) is `activity`. A relative clause saying what a created thing does (容纳) is `process`. A participle of a completed earlier event (遗留下来的) is `performance`.

edit.anchor: - Coreference across sentences is in `:coref`; within a sentence it is a re-entrancy.
